disclosure: Curated projections of runtime evidence, not full unmodified traces or logs. Raw files, artwork, native states and dataset bytes are excluded.

source_identity.base_kind: Exact public merged R3 commit; documentation overlay preserved

timing: The source was frozen with native qualification pending. The selected native and production evidence below was collected later for those same source and wheel bytes; it does not alter the source patch.

selected_native_check.scope: Only this selected installed-wheel five-view test ran; no claim that all 18 native/graphical cases were executed.

input.generator: Original analytic RadiusSquared = x*x + y*y + z*z on a 7x7x7 integer lattice from -3 to 3
input.title_caveat: Time (s) exercises the title property only; the analytic RadiusSquared test field does not measure time.

sdk_trace.record_scope: Actual SDK request/result models and notification records; correlation sequences are not wire JSON-RPC IDs.

selected_production_provenance.scope: Selected native five-panel authoring pass using the same installed wheel; separate from the selected pytest case and from final artwork acceptance.
selected_production_provenance.result: passed native authoring and reopen/capture checks
selected_production_provenance.synthetic_disclaimer: Analytic illustration; illustrative units, no measured seismic data, no PDE or physics validation.

trace.record_scope: Production SDK call/response records and three discovery/initialization records; not the native test JSONL event format.

limits: Only the measured bounded Surface presentation subset is compared; not every possible ParaView property or plugin state.
ParaView 5.13.2 does not expose CameraClippingRange through this view property interface. It is explicitly unavailable, with no camera creation or getter fallback.

Native timeout/cancellation closes the owned host. Forced termination can leave staging files and cannot undo an artifact already published. No transactional cancellation/publication or cross-restart recovery guarantee is claimed.
Control bounds constrain resources but do not guarantee title fit or avoid overlap at every viewport; composition still requires visual review.
Selected production evidence concerns native panel authoring and state retention only. It is not scientific validation or acceptance of a finished artwork.
base_relation: BASE_RELATION.json records the exact public merge base and complete non-documentation byte/mode comparison. The original test and native receipts apply to unchanged implementation bytes; they are not a rerun on a new distribution archive.
